name: game-studio
description: Run a game project as a small studio: a coordinator session plus fresh role agents (feature, UI, art owner, prep, integration, QA, balance, visual review, knowledge keeper, release), with briefs, handoffs, review, pause/resume and safety hooks. Engine- and art-pipeline-agnostic.

engine_process.title: Engine process name
engine_process.description: Substring of the engine/editor process name to count (case-insensitive), e.g. godot, Unity, UnrealEditor. Empty disables the engine-run warning.

max_engine_runs.title: Max concurrent engine runs
max_engine_runs.description: Total engine processes allowed across all workers; the hook warns (never blocks) at this count.

evidence_dir.title: Evidence folder
evidence_dir.description: Project-relative folder for worker evidence and handoffs: <evidence_dir>/<stream>/<task>/.

queue_doc.title: Task queue document
queue_doc.description: Project-relative path of the single task queue the coordinator maintains.
